summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC and Porsche Financial Services, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $911M auto-lease ABS issuance by Porsche Innovative Lease Owner Trust 2026-1. The offering comprises six tranches of Class A notes with fixed and floating rates, priced at par to 99.98759%, with underwriting discount of 0.170%. Credit enhancement includes a 0.25% reserve, excess spread, and overcollateralization. Proceeds fund the depositor. This is a routine asset-backed securitization—not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is involved.
